mapper.sql: select id, stock_month, embryo_code,bom_Data_Version, stock_num, remark, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from t_cx_month_stock
mapper.select:
where del_flag = '0'
and stock_month >= to_date(#{beginStockMonth},'yyyy-MM')
and stock_month < to_date(#{endStockMonth},'yyyy-MM')
and INSTR(embryo_code, #{embryoCode}) > 0 and INSTR(stock_num, #{stockNum}) > 0 and INSTR(bom_Data_Version, #{bomDataVersion}) > 0
order by STOCK_MONTH desc
order by ${orderStr}
mapper.update:
merge into t_cx_month_stock a USING (
select #{ITEM.stockMonth,jdbcType=VARCHAR} stock_month, #{ITEM.embryoCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} embryo_code, #{ITEM.stockNum,jdbcType=DOUBLE} stock_num, #{ITEM.bomDataVersion,jdbcType=DOUBLE} bom_Data_Version,
#{ITEM.createBy,jdbcType=VARCHAR} create_by, #{ITEM.createTime,jdbcType=DATE} create_time, #{ITEM.updateBy,jdbcType=VARCHAR} update_by, #{ITEM.updateTime,jdbcType=DATE} update_time, #{ITEM.remark,jdbcType=VARCHAR} remark from dual
) b ON (a.stock_month = b.stock_month and a.embryo_code = b.embryo_code and a.bom_Data_Version = b.bom_Data_Version and a.del_flag = '0') WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET a.stock_num = b.stock_num, a.update_by = b.create_by, a.update_time = sysdate, a.remark = b.remark WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( a.id , a.stock_month, a.embryo_code, a.bom_Data_Version, a.stock_num , a.create_by , a.create_time , a.remark, a.del_flag ) values (SEQ_CX_MONTHSTOCK.NEXTVAL, b.stock_month, b.embryo_code, b.bom_Data_Version, b.stock_num, b.create_by, sysdate, b.remark, '0' )
